Rules.InvariantScript: Remove([@FurnitureInspections], selectedRecord); If(IsEmpty(Errors([@FurnitureInspections], selectedRecord)), UpdateContext( { CurrentItem: First([@FurnitureInspections]), itemSelected: false, editMode: false, newMode: false, deleteMode: false }));
If(And(MainScreen1.Size = ScreenSize.Small, Or(newMode, editMode, itemSelected)), false, true)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString: Set(varInspectionId, "FI-" & Text(Now(), "[$-en-US]yyyymmddhhmmss") & "-" & Left(Text(GUID()), 8)); Set(varItemNumber, Blank()); Set(varSerialNumber, Blank()); NewForm(Form1); UpdateContext({ newMode: true, editMode: false, itemSelected: true })

Rules.InvariantScript: SortByColumns(Filter([@FurnitureInspections], IsBlank(SearchInput1.Text) || StartsWith(InspectionID, SearchInput1.Text) || StartsWith(ItemNumber, SearchInput1.Text) || StartsWith(SerialNumber, SearchInput1.Text)), "ID", SortOrder.Descending)

If(
    Or(
        IsBlank(DataCardValue4.Text),
        IsBlank(DataCardValue5.Text),
        IsBlank(DataCardValue6.Text),
        IsBlank(DataCardValue7.Text),
        IsBlank(DataCardValue10.Text)
    ),
    Notify(
        "Please fill ItemNumber, SerialNumber, IssueFrom, DamagedDescription, and WhseDealWithStatus.",
        NotificationType.Error
    ),
    If(
        Not(DataCardValue6.Text in ["Ashton", "Vendor"]),
        Notify("IssueFrom must be Ashton or Vendor.", NotificationType.Error),
        If(
            Or(
                CountRows(DataCardValue15.Attachments) < 3,
                CountRows(DataCardValue15.Attachments) > 20
            ),
            Notify("Please upload 3 to 20 high-resolution photo attachments.", NotificationType.Error),
            SubmitForm(Form1)
        )
    )
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString: If(Or(IsBlank(DataCardValue4.Text), IsBlank(DataCardValue5.Text), IsBlank(DataCardValue6.Text), IsBlank(DataCardValue7.Text), IsBlank(DataCardValue10.Text)), Notify("Please fill ItemNumber, SerialNumber, IssueFrom, DamagedDescription, and WhseDealWithStatus.", NotificationType.Error), If(Not(DataCardValue6.Text in ["Ashton", "Vendor"]), Notify("IssueFrom must be Ashton or Vendor.", NotificationType.Error), If(Or(CountRows(DataCardValue15.Attachments) < 10, CountRows(DataCardValue15.Attachments) > 20), Notify("Please upload 10 to 20 high-resolution photo attachments.", NotificationType.Error), SubmitForm(Form1))))

Rules.InvariantScript: ResetForm(Form1); Set(varInspectionId, Blank()); Set(varItemNumber, Blank()); Set(varSerialNumber, Blank()); UpdateContext({ editMode: false, newMode: false })
UpdateContext({ editMode: true, selectedRecord: RecordsGallery1.Selected }); Set(varItemNumber, RecordsGallery1.Selected.ItemNumber); Set(varSerialNumber, RecordsGallery1.Selected.SerialNumber)
UpdateContext({ deleteMode: true, deleteCancelled: false, selectedRecord: RecordsGallery1.Selected })
Notify("无法保存。请检查窗体中是否存在错误。", NotificationType.Error)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString: UpdateContext({ CurrentItem: Self.LastSubmit, editMode: false, newMode: false, itemSelected: true }); Set(varInspectionId, Blank()); Set(varItemNumber, Blank()); Set(varSerialNumber, Blank()); Notify("Inspection saved: " & Self.LastSubmit.InspectionID, NotificationType.Success)
